import pandas as pd

# Load source data
source_path_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_64/training_0.csv"
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source_path_0, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: group_by on Source3_64_0.customer_id with aggregations sum(amount), avg(amount)
agg_df = df_source0.groupby("customer_id", as_index=False).agg(
    amount_x=pd.NamedAgg(column="amount", aggfunc="sum"),
    avg_amount_spent=pd.NamedAgg(column="amount", aggfunc="mean"),
)

# Rename avg_amount_spent to float type explicitly (pandas mean returns float by default)
agg_df["avg_amount_spent"] = agg_df["avg_amount_spent"].astype(float)

# Operation 2: JOIN : [["Source3_64_0", "Source3_64_0"], ["customer_id", "customer_id"]]
# Join the aggregated result with the original source on customer_id
joined_df = pd.merge(
    agg_df,
    df_source0[["customer_id", "amount"]],
    how="inner",
    on="customer_id",
    suffixes=("", "_y"),
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
# amount_x already from aggregation sum(amount)
# amount_y is the amount column from the original source (float in target schema)
# avg_amount_spent is from aggregation avg(amount)
joined_df.rename(columns={"amount": "amount_y"}, inplace=True)

# Convert amount_x to integer as per target schema
joined_df["amount_x"] = joined_df["amount_x"].astype(int)

# Convert amount_y to float as per target schema
joined_df["amount_y"] = joined_df["amount_y"].astype(float)

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema
target_df = joined_df[["customer_id", "amount_x", "amount_y", "avg_amount_spent"]]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_64/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

    "amount_x": "sum",

})
